notes.title: Sprout 1.1 is here
notes.excerpt: Eight painted scenes, painted plants and a shelf that feels alive.
body: Sprout 1.1 is out, and your shelf has a new home.

The window is now a painted scene. There are eight to choose from: a cottage garden, a greenhouse, an autumn terrace, a moonlit terrace, a city balcony, a lake dock, a rainy terrace and a fuji veranda. You will find them in the Shop, under Scenes.
The plants are painted too, and the shelf is alive: rain on the terrace, falling leaves, fireflies after dark, and plants that sway in the breeze.
If Sprout makes your days a little brighter, a rating on the App Store helps more people find it. Thank you for growing with me.
